title: Checkpoint evidence v1
description: Machine-readable evidence envelope for publication checkpoints. T030 freezes the C1 shape for the currently implemented empty runtime surface; later checkpoints reuse the same schema once C2+ exposes routes.

checkpoint_id.description: Publication checkpoint identifier from the initial-implementation plan.

application_operations.description: Stable D004 operation IDs exposed by the candidate. For C1 this MUST be empty: root help exposes zero application routes and the runtime catalog arrives in C2.

workspace_build.description: cargo check --workspace --locked (and format/Clippy as required by development policy).

dependency_policy.description: cargo run --locked -p xtask -- dependencies (selected equivalent) and/or cargo deny check

staged_pre_commit.description: Versioned pre-commit / staged-tree path (xtask hooks pre-commit).

empty_runtime_surface.description: Root CLI help exposes zero application routes; no runtime operation catalog entries yet.

status.description: Evidence disposition. T030 produces a candidate for orchestrator commit `build: establish workspace governance`.

detail.description: Optional short diagnostic or evidence pointer.
